text_block_list.text:
Lately, I feel like I often see Cesario 
staying behind after training.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: You're working so hard this late. ...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: You're so diligent, staying this l...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was just organizing the information I 
wanted to compile.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that someday, I can answer their 
wishes.

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario-oneesan was super fast and the 
coolest of all!"

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"When I grow up, I want to run with you 
too, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I asked Mommy,
and she said if I get into 
Tracen Academy, I can meet you!"

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm gonna go see you one day, so please 
teach me how to run!’"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if she does come to Tracen 
Academy, by then,
I'll likely have retired 
from active competition."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"However, as an instructor, I can help 
carry her feelings into the future."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The experiences I've gained since 
enrolling... and the experiences I have 
yet to gain...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Compiling that into solid "knowledge"
will 
serve as a guide for future generations, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Showing how you shine right now is...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Showing off our success right now ...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Feelings of admiration look toward the 
future, while inherited experience pushes 
them forward from behind...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "That is how we will build the next era."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As for me...
I can't help but look forward 
to it, even now.
